title: Sandiganbayan acquits ex-Albay Gov. Grex Lagman in ‘jueteng’ payola case
summary: The Sandiganbayan Third Division acquitted former Albay Gov. Edcel Greco Lagman of indirect bribery and violation of the anti-illegal numbers games law.
